metadata.description: Session trackers and a budget guard for Claude Code, built as mods (function hooks): what fills your context, how fast you burn your plan quota, what each turn costs, and a stop before you pass a limit you set.

plugins.name: context-lens
plugins.description: Live /context: what fills the window, per-turn growth, and distance to auto-compaction.

plugins.name: quota-meter
plugins.description: 5-hour and weekly plan limits with reset countdown and projected time until you hit them.

plugins.name: token-ledger
plugins.description: Per-turn cost, tokens and cache hit ratio, with the session total.

plugins.name: budget-guard
plugins.description: Stops a session before it runs past a budget: warns near a cost or plan-window limit, then refuses tool calls and asks before the next prompt.
